pages.text: Two genes that each switch the other off make a toggle: it rests in one state or the other. It can latch, and hold its state, only when each represses the other steeply enough, cooperativity n > 1; at n = 1 there is one state and no memory.
$(thing)Set$(): Promoter A, Cooperativity.$(br2)$(thing)Disturbance$(): Leaky promoter: the stability varies by +/- 2%.d.
$(thing)Limits$(): At n = 1 it cannot latch.$(br2)$(thing)Rate$(): A firm switch is faster.
$(thing)Equations$()$(br)Bistability: latches when n > 1 and A ~ B
